UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Private user identity and email profile isolated under the user's own subtree.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

UserStudyDocument.title: UserStudyDocument
UserStudyDocument.description: Cross-device synchronized study state including bookmarks, highlights, notes, collections, custom graph links, read chapters, and saved graphs.

bookmarks.description: Bounded list of bookmarked canonical OSIS verse IDs (max 500).

readChapters.description: Bounded list of completed chapters formatted as BOOK.CH (max 1189).

highlights.description: Map of OSIS verse ID to highlight color.

notes.description: Map of OSIS verse ID to personal study note.

collections.description: Array of user study collection objects (max 50).

savedGraphs.description: Array of saved graph workspace configurations (max 24).

customEdges.description: Array of user-authored custom cross-reference edges (max 250).

SharedStudyCollection.title: SharedStudyCollection
SharedStudyCollection.description: Publicly readable snapshot of a user study collection accessible by direct share link ID.

authorLabel.description: Non-PII attribution label displayed on shared collection.

verseIds.description: Bounded list of canonical verse IDs in the shared collection (max 200).

/users/{userId}/private/profile.description: Isolated PII document storing the authenticated user's profile.

/users/{userId}/studyState/main.description: Synced personal study workspace document owned exclusively by userId.

/sharedCollections/{shareId}.description: Read-only shared study collection retrievable by share link; listing restricted to ownerId.
